title: 第一卷 第17章 怎么会是他第一卷 第18章 怪病
slug: 徒儿下山祸害你七个师姐去吧

然而，胡中一的目光落在刚刚前来叶青云身上的时候，眼睛猛地瞪大，急忙招呼道。
“叶大师，你来了！快快请坐！”
“坐就免了，我是专门前来教你鬼门十三针的。”
叶青云开口道。
胡中一闻言，脸上笑得像一朵老菊花，连声回道。
“好好叶大师，你稍等，我这就去拿准备。”
胡中一说完，一路小跑出去。
看得叶青云眼皮一跳。
这小老头身子还挺硬朗的嘛！
不多时，胡中一手中拎着一个箱子回来了。
这个箱子里可是胡中一珍藏多年的宝贝，一套银针。
平时胡中一都不舍得拿这套银针出来给人治病。
今日叶青云要教他鬼门十三针，他觉得是时候了！
胡中一打开箱子，恭敬的对叶青云说道。
“叶大师，请！”
叶青云手持一枚银针。
在他的面前是一个成年人比例的人形模具，上面标注着各处穴位的名称。
“老先生，既然你能施展鬼门七针。
那么对于鬼门针法的理念以及手法，想必你是明白的。

接下来。我在你面前缓慢地施展一套鬼门十三针，你注意看。”
胡中一连连点头，瞪大眼睛。
他这模样像极了认真听讲的小学生。
“请叶大师指点！”
唰！
叶青云将一枚银针刺进人形模具的体内。
他刻意放缓速度，以便让胡中一更好的进行观摩。
胡中一瞪大眼睛，全神贯注，不舍得遗漏一点细节。
唰！
随着第十三根银针刺入人形模型中，叶青云收手，看了一眼胡中一。
此时的胡中一看得如痴如醉，整个人沉浸在这鬼门十三针的奥妙之中。
叶青云眼见胡中一如此状态，并没有选择打扰。
胡中一如此痴迷中医，让叶青云对这老头增添几分好感。
不多时，胡中一从顿悟的状态回过神来。
脸上若有所思，自顾自的拿起银针，在人形模型上练习。
对于鬼门针法的前七针，胡中一的动作行云流水，没有丝毫拖沓。
直到第八针的时候，他的动作有了明显的停顿。
但，依旧被他施展出来。
叶青云暗自点头。
天赋不错。

随后，胡中一极为艰难的施展出第十一针后，手悬在空中半天，始终无法落下。

However, when Hu Zhongyi's eyes fell on Ye Qingyun, who had just arrived, his eyes widened suddenly and he hurriedly greeted him.
"Master Ye, you are here! Please sit down quickly!"
"You don't have to sit down. I'm here specifically to teach you the Thirteen Needles of the Ghost Gate."
Ye Qingyun said.
When Hu Zhong heard this, his face smiled like an old chrysanthemum, and he replied repeatedly.
"Okay Master Ye, just wait a moment, I'll go get it ready."
After Hu Zhong finished speaking, he trotted out.
Ye Qingyun's eyelids jumped at this sight.
This little old man is quite strong!
Not long after, Hu Zhongyi came back with a box in his hand.
Inside this box is a treasure that Hu Zhongyi has treasured for many years, a set of silver needles.
Normally, Hu Zhongyi would not be willing to use this set of silver needles to treat people's illnesses.
Today, Ye Qingyun was going to teach him the Thirteen Needles of the Ghost Gate, and he felt it was time!
As soon as Hu Zhong opened the box, he respectfully said to Ye Qingyun.
"Master Ye, please!"
Ye Qingyun holds a silver needle.
In front of him was a human-shaped mold with adult proportions, with the names of various acupuncture points marked on it.
"Old sir, since you can use the Seven Needles of the Ghost Gate.
So you must understand the concept and techniques of Guimen Acupuncture.
Next. I am slowly performing a set of Thirteen Needles of the Ghost Gate in front of you, please pay attention. "
Hu Zhong nodded repeatedly and widened his eyes.
He looked like a primary school student who listened carefully.
"Master Ye, please give me some advice!"
Uh-huh!
Ye Qingyun inserted a silver needle into the body of the humanoid mold.
He deliberately slowed down so that Hu Zhongyi could observe better.
Hu Zhongyi opened his eyes wide and concentrated, not wanting to miss any detail.
Uh-huh!
As the thirteenth silver needle pierced into the humanoid model, Ye Qingyun stopped his hand and glanced at Hu Zhongyi.
At this moment, Hu Zhongyi was mesmerized by the sight, immersed in the mystery of the Thirteen Needles of the Ghost Gate.
Seeing Hu Zhongyi in such a state, Ye Qingyun did not choose to disturb him.
Hu Zhongyi is so obsessed with Chinese medicine, which makes Ye Qingyun even more fond of the old man.
Not long after, Hu Zhongyi came back from his state of enlightenment.
With a thoughtful look on his face, he picked up the silver needle and practiced on the human model.
For the first seven stitches of Guimen Acupuncture, Hu Zhongyi's movements were smooth and smooth, without any delay.
It was not until the eighth needle that his movements paused significantly.
However, he still displayed it.
Ye Qingyun nodded secretly.
Good talent.
Then, after Hu Zhongyi performed the eleventh stitch with great difficulty, his hand hung in the air for a long time and could not fall down.
